result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but one header control appears incomplete and the fixed navigation obscures feed content.

issues.description: The circular control in the upper-right is visually empty except for a small red dot, making it look like its icon or avatar failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended profile, map, or notification icon and position any red status badge at the circle’s edge.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the restaurant card beneath it, hiding a substantial portion of the image while scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable feed equal to the navigation height plus the safe-area inset so content can scroll fully above the bar.
